remaining_limits: DMA exposes one input and power-of-two system-clock sample divisors. External-clock/multi-pin DMA and sample-accurate edge triggering remain software extensions; digital testing of those is not blocked by the present paired wiring.
Pretrigger samples a high/low level at 4096-sample page boundaries. Short pulses can be missed; exact event-time placement is not independently measured.

One session shared by native acquisitions. DMA retains six 128-word pages without a consumer; ordinary rings retain 1023 entries. The 115200-baud host link cannot sustain the 22.5 MB/s full-clock stream; a faster sink and driver are needed.
USB operating mode 27 requires removing the chosen pair's hard short, separate DM/DP wiring, safe VBUS handling and a protocol stack. No USB attempts on current pairs.

External UART/SPI/ADC devices, real SMPS power circuitry and independent analog/clock performance require appropriate devices and instruments. Current pair wiring provides only two independent voltages within one four-pin scope group.
Divided raw ADC samples can alias; density/monotonic transfer is not calibrated voltage, ENOB or bandwidth. Existing SINC service supplies filtered ADC samples.
